dims_mm.note: d_max derived: 22 mm body + 17.5 mm battery pack (vendor gives no combined figure)

weight_g.note: Spec image says 'Approx. 729 g (With battery)', but the external battery alone weighs about 380 g, so the label cannot be right. Value not used.

ports.note: Spec image: 'Full-Featured USB-C 4.0'; store gallery: Thunderbolt 4 interface for the OneXPlayer GPU dock

screen.note: 30-144 Hz VRR; 700 nits HBM; 1100 nits HDR peak (store text); 100% DCI-P3

battery.note: Blade-style snap-on pack with built-in kickstand, about 380 g

controls.stick_note: Capacitive joysticks, 9 mm height, 22 degree tilt, RGB; same joystick part as the X2 Mini Pro and OneXPlayer 3
controls.note: Dual-stage adjustable triggers with a physical switch; swappable 8/4-way D-pad

cooling: Dual 5400 RPM fans, 4 copper heat pipes, 47,200 mm2 fins; 45 W sustained
notes: Intel version of the X2 Mini Pro shell. The X2 Mini was first teased (April 2026) with a Ryzen AI Max+ 395; that design became the X2 Mini Pro (Max+ 388). US store sells 32 GB/1 TB only; the spec image also lists 24 GB at 7467 MT/s. Store price $1,999 at launch, MSRP $2,199.
